title: Bowery Boys Tastes of Chinatown: Food & History Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Delve into the rich culinary and cultural tapestry of Chinatown on this engaging 3-hour walking tour. Sample four delicious savory dishes and a dessert while exploring the neighborhood's history, from the iconic egg roll’s creation to tales of local heroes and historical figures. This small-group experience allows you to savor authentic Chinese cuisine and learn about the vibrant community that has thrived for over 150 years. Your licensed guide will share fascinating stories that connect food with the cultural heritage of Chinatown, making each bite a flavorful lesson in history.

- Enjoy four savory dishes and one dessert, with vegetarian and gluten-free options available
- Discover the history of Chinatown, including landmark stories and cultural heritage
- Small group size of up to 8 guests for a personalized experience
- Conveniently located meeting point near 1 Pike Street, ending near Columbus Park
